Your template MUST reuse that kit + pv-* system so it stays in the same design system.

**Merge the best of each into one flagship (`/preview/game-combined`, new component `components/marketing/gamelanding/GameLandingCombined.tsx`):**
- From **Cinematic**: the full-bleed cinematic game key-art hero + the genuinely-animated live server panel (ticking player count, drawn TPS graph, streaming console), asymmetric split.
- From **Editorial**: the numbered buying-reasons rail with the scroll-linked progress spine, and the sticky plan card whose 47-second deploy ring counts up as it pins.
- From **Command Deck**: a HUD/console moment — a deploy terminal that types its boot sequence to "✓ online in 47s" and animated telemetry gauges.
Compose these into one coherent premium page (don't just stack all three — curate: cinematic hero + live panel up top, numbered reasons + sticky plan card mid, a console/terminal deploy beat, plan cards, compact 5-star reviews, cinematic CTA). Use a game with rich art (Rust or Palworld — check `public/games/art/<slug>_hero.jpg`/`_poster.jpg`).

**SHARED DESIGN LANGUAGE (applies to your build):** brand tokens navy-950 #060a14 / brand-500 #6f47f5 / brand-400 #8a70fb / accent-blue #3b82f6 / accent-cyan #22d3ee, Geist font, `grad-text`, `.card`, `.btn-primary`/`.btn-deploy`, `hero-aura`, glass surfaces + violet glow; cyan is the "live/active" pop, never amber except warnings. Lead with "Your server is 47 seconds away." Include a compact 5-star review element. Real game art as the centerpiece; asymmetric/editorial layout (NOT centered-stack). Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; mobile-responsive (verify 390w). FORBIDDEN (rejected "AI slop"): the centered eyebrow→stacked-headline→particle-canvas→3-up-grid→pricing→CTA skeleton; fake globes; dead-space cards; walls of text.

**Constraints:** build NET-NEW files only; do NOT touch existing live pages, `GameLandingPage`, `MarketingHeader`, or existing components. You MAY append scoped `pv-*` CSS to globals.css (re-read it first; other agents are concurrently appending). Verify `npx tsc --noEmit` clean. Do NOT run `npm run build`. For screenshots, best-effort: `PORT=3778 npm run dev` + Playwright, desktop 1440w + mobile 390w, save to `/opt/nxeon-staging/.design-previews/` as `combined-*.png`; if the dev server conflicts with concurrent agents, skip and note it (the main session will screenshot). Shut your dev server down after.

Report: the route, the game used, which elements you pulled from which direction, screenshot paths (or note if skipped), and anything that didn't render cleanly.

## Elements merged (curated, not stacked)

- **From Cinematic:** full-bleed Rust key-art hero with scroll parallax + navy scrims, asymmetric 6/6 split; the genuinely-animated `LiveOpsPanel` (ticking player count `useJitter`, drawn TPS sparkline via `pv-draw`, streaming console via `animate-line-in`, `grow-up` player-slot grid); the "Your server is 47 seconds away." cyan live hook; the 3-up `PlanCard`s; and the blurred-art cinematic CTA.
- **From Editorial:** the numbered buying-reasons rail with the scroll-linked progress **spine** (`useScrollProgress`) beside a **sticky recommended plan card** whose 47-second `DeployRing` counts up as it pins (`useCountUp`), plus a "Compare all 3 plans ↓" anchor.
- **From Command Deck:** a HUD **deploy beat** — a glass terminal (corner brackets + `pv-scan` scanline + `pv-grid-pan` grid) that types its boot sequence to "✓ online in 47s" (`useTypedLines`) next to animated telemetry **gauges** (`grow-x`, uptime/healthy).

Page flow: cinematic hero + live panel → reasons spine + sticky plan card → HUD terminal deploy beat → full 3-up plans → compact 5-star reviews → cinematic CTA.

## Design-system fidelity
Built entirely on the shared `kit.tsx` hooks/atoms and the existing `pv-*` motion system — I did **not** add any new CSS to `globals.css` (achieved with existing `pv-*` + `animate-*` utilities only), so there's **zero conflict risk** with the other agents concurrently appending to it. Navy ground, violet accent, cyan reserved for the "live/47s" pop, Geist, `grad-text`, `.card`/glass surfaces, `btn-deploy`, `hero-aura`-style glows, real game art centerpiece, asymmetric layout. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` (all `pv-*`/count/type/jitter hooks resolve to resting values). None of the forbidden AI-slop skeleton.
